title: cplane-evening-bridge-brief-2028-04-09
body:
Evening bridge brief (Amber shift) - quick handover notes and action items.

Context and purpose:
- Short form handoff from day ops to evening team. Focus: control plane latency spike mitigation, routing fallback readiness, quota anomalies, and auth token refresh rollout. Not a replacement for full incident writeup; pointers and owners below.

What happened today (summary):
- 14:12 PDT: transient 95p latency spike on control-plane write path (auth calls + route resolution). Impacted a handful of Dedicated customers (4).
  - Symptom: write API calls P95 jumped from ~48ms -> ~420ms for ~7 minutes. Errors stayed low (~0.4% 5xx increase).
  - Root-cause signal: sudden queue buildup in route-resolver workers; CPU pinned due to a GC/heap expansion in a new preview allocator image.
- Quota signals: automated quota-scraper produced several low-confidence fallthrough triggers for tenant buckets with burst policy set. Most were noise but two tenants hit a soft-limit momentarily.
- Auth: partial rollout (20%) of rotating short-lived tokens completed for internal controlplane services. One retry-loop surfaced in auth client when token expiration window misinterpreted (bug noted).

Immediate mitigation taken:
- Rolled back allocator-preview image on cplane route-resolver (Arjun). Queues drained; latency returned to baseline by 14:20.
- Enabled emergency routing-fallback policy for tier-2 customers for 30m to reduce pressure while we investigate.
- Manual throttle added for the two tenants that hit soft-limits to avoid cascading quota recalcs.

Current status:
- Control plane latency: stable at baseline (P95 ~ 55ms).
- Route-resolver workers: stable on last known-good image.
- Quotas: soft-limits held; monitoring alert remains active (quiet).
- Auth token rollout: paused; token-refresh library PR queued for review.

Notes to evening shift (things to watch):
- Watch for reappearance of P95 > 200ms in write path (Alert: PLAT-LAT-09). If seen: check route-resolver pod CPU and GC logs immediately.
- Keep an eye on quota fallthrough signal spikes — threshold: > 3 tenants in 10m window. That indicates a mis-evaluated burst policy.
- Auth: if token-related 401s increase, revert to static token mode for affected internal clients (runbook link below).

Action items (owners + ETA):
- Arjun P: follow up on allocator-preview heap profile root-cause; collect flamegraphs and share in PR (ETA: EOD tomorrow).
- Elena G: harden quota-scraper confidence scoring (reduce false positives), prototype rule to require corroborating metric before triggering fallthrough (ETA: next sprint spike).
- Kai T: finish token-refresh client fix (PR opened: /pull/512) and schedule canary re-run at 10% for next weekday morning (ETA: 48hrs).
- Maya C (owner of this note): update control plane runbook with the temporary routing-fallback bypass steps and the emergency throttle commands (ETA: today end-of-shift).

Open questions / discussion items:
- Should we throttle preview-image deploys through a stricter canary gate (e.g., automatic CPU/latency abort)? Pros: fewer surprises; cons: slows iteration. Deferring to release-eng for policy.
- Quota fallthrough: do we trust the scraper or is there a systemic delay in metrics ingestion creating false conditions? Need a short audit.

Quick references (runbooks & troubleshooting):
- Control plane incident runbook: Confluence: /display/PLAT/Control+Plane+Runbook
- Emergency routing fallback CLI: docs/runbooks/routing-fallback.md (cheat commands in the runbook)
- Quota-scraper dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/quotas
- Route-resolver flamegraphs: PR link in linked_artifacts (will be attached once Arjun uploads).

Hand-off checklist (evening team):
- Confirm allocator-preview remains rolled back across all clusters.
- Re-run quota-scraper locally for the two tenants and confirm the soft-limit behavior is reproducible.
- Validate auth client PR tests (unit + integration); if green, coordinate a small canary with Kai.
- Post any suspicious logs to #platform-amber-shift with snippet and pod id.

Misc notes / notes-to-self style fragments:
- low-priority: consider adding a small backpressure token bucket in route-resolver to protect delta spikes from GC storms.
- reminder: follow up with release-eng on a 'canary abort on P95' feature.

Meeting follow-ups scheduled:
- Deep-dive: allocator preview flamegraph review (30m) — with Arjun, release-eng — 2028-04-11 09:00 PT.
- Quota-scraper audit sync (15m) — with Elena, metrics — 2028-04-12 11:00 PT.

Signed off by: Maya Chen (Amber shift lead)

— end of brief —
